name: LaunchDarkly
label: LaunchDarkly REST API
description: LaunchDarkly REST API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://launchdarkly.com/docs/api. Operations: flag_get, flag_list, flag_toggle, flag_patch, segment_get, environment_list, listen. Auth is Authorization: <token> with no Bearer prefix. Every request sends LD-API-Version: 20240415 via extraHeaders (https://launchdarkly.com/docs/guides/api/api-migration-guide). Auth secret api_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: flag_get | flag_list | flag_toggle | flag_patch | segment_get | environment_list | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'flag_get'.

schema.label: featureKey
schema.description: Flag key for flag_get / flag_toggle / flag_patch. Example: checkout-v2.

schema.label: environmentKey
schema.description: Environment key for segment_get (path) and to build JSON-patch paths for flag_toggle. Example: production.

schema.label: patch
schema.description: JSON Patch array sent as the whole PATCH /flags/{projectKey}/{featureKey} body for flag_toggle and flag_patch. Each item is {op, path, value}. Example: [{"op":"replace","path":"/environments/production/on","value":true}]. https://launchdarkly.com/docs/api/feature-flags/patch-feature-flag

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: flag_get, flag_list, flag_toggle, flag_patch, segment_get, environment_list, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: LaunchDarkly access token. Authorization: <token> (no Bearer). LD-API-Version: 20240415 is sent via extraHeaders (https://launchdarkly.com/docs/guides/api/rest-api). Flag changes are production traffic.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
